summary: A ten-track groovebox firmware, forked from X0X, where any of its engines can play on any track, with clip launching and scatter effects for live play. Still a beta.
features: 10 tracks, 28 engines incl. two kicks, 909 and 808 voices, ACID, FM4
64 clips per track; 16, 32 or 64 steps with rates, directions, swing
Scatter effects on the keys for one track or the whole mix
Two master send effects from reverb and delay to comb and phaser
Four assignable master knobs: volume, DJ filter, FX amounts, BPM
Arpeggiator, quantised recording and an always-on master compressor
